draft.overall: NXL led the gainers in this range, up 76 percent from the prior close, after Nexalin announced a 10-year exclusive distribution and local-manufacturing agreement for Brazil and South America. NAMM was up 35 percent, with first-half 2026 results and a business update found in our sources. EJH was up 26 percent, with an AI service robot launch found alongside a private-placement agreement. Fresh news was found in our sources for 6 of the 12 names the desk covers.

lines.text: At 08:30 ET on October 1, 2026, Nexalin announced a definitive 10-year exclusive distribution and local-manufacturing agreement covering Brazil and South America, framed by the company as a step toward commercial revenue. The desk reads it as a company-specific commercialization story that secondary coverage tied to the surge on heavy volume, though no contract value, minimum purchases or revenue figure is on file.

This is not a fresh catalyst: the latest item found is the September 3, 2026 retail launch of Perfecta plant-based meat in the Northeastern U.S., its first U.S. shelf placement, with no sales or store-count figure disclosed. Since the previous checkpoint it was down 18.1% and lost $0.83 support.

The desk treats it as a company-specific revenue opportunity released alongside heavy trading, though the performance period and revenue timing are not on file.

The desk sees an AI headline that drew attention against sizable prospective supply priced below the market, with closing of the placement not established.
